title: Constant module local isomorphisms on corresponding slices
statement: Let g:Y→X be a scheme morphism, B a commutative ring, F a module sheaf over g⁻¹(B_X), M a B-module, and V an object of the equivalent AsSmall site of Y. There is an isomorphism of F restricted to AsSmall.down(V) with the restriction of g⁻¹ of the constant M-module on X if and only if the explicit coefficient transport of F restricted to V is isomorphic to the restriction of the constantCoefficientModule associated with the same M on the small site. No finiteness hypothesis on B or M is imposed.

proof.text: Apply the slice equivalence for arbitrary module sheaves to F and the inverse-image constant module, then compose with the identification of the transported constant model.
For the reverse implication, compose the given transported local isomorphism with the inverse of the constant-model identification and use the reverse direction of the slice equivalence.

theorem relativeFiniteConstantSliceComparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B]
    (F : pbcModules Y ((adicTowerInverseImage g).obj (adicLisseConstantRing X B)))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) (V : proEtaleSiteModel Y) :
    Nonempty (F.over (AsSmall.down.obj V) ≅
      ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage g (adicLisseConstantRing X B)).obj
        ((adicLisseConstantModules X B).obj M)).over (AsSmall.down.obj V)) ↔
    Nonempty (((relativeFiniteModelModules g B).obj F).over V ≅
      ((SheafOfModules.constantCoefficientModule (proEtaleModelTopology Y) B).obj M).over V)
